title: A BOON TO PHYSICIANS
instructions: Crystallose, therefore, is a boon to physicians, because it enables them to give their patients a perfect substitute for sugar, as far as taste is concerned, while in every other respect--as to purity, safety, etc.,--it fills the bill completely.
Crystallose may be obtained in one-half grain or one grain tablets or crystals from any first-class druggist.
A. KLIPSTEIN &amp; CO., 122 Pearl St., New York.
